COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS 
28.04.2023 WPSB No. 218 of 2022
Sri Vipin Sanghi, C.J.
Sri Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. B.S. Adhikari, learned counsel for the 
petitioner. 
2. The submission of Mr. Adhikari, learned counsel 
for the petitioner is that the reason for delayed filing of 
the Memorial was explained by the petitioner by 
stating that he has not been served with a copy of the 
appellate order, and he had obtained the same upon 
his asking from the respondents, soon thereafter, the 
Memorial was preferred. 
3. The impugned order passed by the Chairman￾cum-Managing Director & Memorial Authority dated 
09.12.2021 records that this submission of the 
petitioner is false and misleading since, as per the 
official record, a copy of the appellate order was 
already received by the petitioner on 18.08.2017. 
4. Since this position is disputed by the petitioner, 
to verify this position, issue notice to the respondents 
by all permitted modes, including electronically, 
returnable by 13.06.2023. 
5. Steps to be taken within a week. 
6. List on 13.06.2023. 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.) (Vipin Sanghi, C.J.) 
 28.04.2023 28.04.2023 
NISHANT
